heading_quote: BS-2. Lincoln Address Memorial (Drawing 3.2)
name_as_printed: Lincoln Address Memorial
name_ordinals_joined: Lincoln Address Memorial
period_quote: An open-air octagonal frame summerhouse designed and built on flagstaff site in 1881 by C. H. Comfort of Gettysburg, intended to allow visitors to take in the view south across the battlefield. Building removed in 1911 for construction of the Lincoln Address Memorial, designed by Louis Henrick in ca. 1904, with a bust of Lincoln by Henry Kirke Bush-Brown.
